friendly_name: App shell with all its states
purpose_context: Every mission screen in the dashboard and Kitty Desktop sits inside the same frame: top bar, navigation rail and context sidebar. Building that shell first, with all its layouts (picker, project, mission) and its width-driven expanded, collapsed and mobile states, gives later screen missions one consistent, reviewed frame to drop into. Source: issue #2.
purpose_tldr: Build the shared application shell for mission screens, with every layout and width state visible in the workbench.
